payload.content: constrained_batches() validates max_size but not max_count; a nonpositive max_count should raise ValueError the same way max_size already does.

entries.note: more_itertools/more.py is a single ~5600-line file holding every public function; tests live in tests/test_more.py in one TestCase per function, named FooTests for a function foo().
one() and only() share the exact same `raise too_long or ValueError(msg)` block -- fixing one without the other passes locally but fails the regression gate on the other.

entries.example_diff_summary: `raise X or default` silently drops a falsy X; replace with an explicit `if X is not None: raise X` / `else` split.
